WITH account_orders AS (
    SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS order_count
    FROM "order"
    GROUP BY account_id
),
shares AS (
    SELECT order_count * 1.0 / SUM(order_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM account_orders
),
average AS (
    SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share
    FROM shares
)
SELECT
    SUM(ao.order_count) AS total_orders,
    AVG(ao.order_count * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(order_count) FROM account_orders)) AS average_share,
    AVG(ao.order_count * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(order_count) FROM account_orders) - a.avg_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM account_orders AS ao
CROSS JOIN average AS a
WHERE ao.order_count * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(order_count) FROM account_orders) > a.avg_share
